params.blurb: {{sbc|Innate:}} {{ci|Fiddlesticks}} has a {{ii|Scarecrow Effigy}} in place of a trinket, which will imitate '''Fiddlesticks'''. '''Fiddlesticks''' can impersonate an effigy by remaining idle [[Combat status|out of combat]].
params.blurb2: After level 6, placing an effigy will also summon a {{tip|Sweeper Drone}} over the area for a few seconds.
params.description: {{sbc|Innate - Scarecrow Effigy:}} '''Fiddlesticks''' begins the game with an exclusive {{ii|Scarecrow Effigy}}, which permanently occupies the [[Trinket item|trinket]] slot. '''Fiddlesticks''' can pretend to be an ''Effigy'' by standing still and not acting nor being acted upon for 2 seconds, during which it hides its [[health bar]], adjusts its body into a scarecrow and extends its arm out to expose its lantern.
params.description2: {{sbc|Innate - A Harmless Scarecrow:}} From {{stil|experience|level}} 6 onward, placing an {{tip|Effigy}} also summons a {{tip|Sweeper Drone}} at the location for 6 seconds.
params.notes:
* The 2-second duration stated in the ability description is not accurate. The actual time required is slightly longer and appears to be inconsistent. It usually takes approximately {{tt|{{fd|2.2}} seconds|Estimated}}, but may take up to {{tt|{{fd|4.4}} seconds|Estimated}} after casting a spell for unknown reasons.
* Attempting to impersonate an ''Effigy'', or maintaining the impersonation, will be interrupted if '''Fiddlesticks''':
** Moves.
*** There is a brief grace period after moving where '''Fiddlesticks''' is still considered an ''effigy''.
** Is affected by a {{tip|crowd control}} effect.
** {{pft}} Is hit by an ability.<!--ally abilities? what ability doesn't cc or damage?-->
** Takes damage.
*** '''Fiddlesticks''' can still enter the ''effigy'' state while taking damage from non-champion units due to the preparation time being uninterrupted by non-champion damage.
*** {{ui|Ocean Drake}} and {{ui|Hextech Drake}} are exceptions, as their attacks apply crowd control effects which interfere with the impersonation.
** Declares an attack.
** Casts an ability or summoner spell.
** Uses an item's active effect, potion, or consumable, including [[Named item effect#Support Quest|Support Quest items]] and {{ii|Control Ward}}.
*** Using {{ii|Scarecrow Effigy}} does not interrupt the impersonation.
** Begins {{tip|channel|channeling}}.
* While pretending to be an effigy, when standing within a 225 radius of a {{bi|Faelights|faelight}}, '''Fiddlesticks''' imitates superward visual effects for {{tt|39 seconds|estimated}} or until interrupted.
** While within 75-225 radius of a faelight, '''Fiddlesticks''' will {{tip|blink}} into a 75 radius of the faelight's location.
* The trinket slot can still be temporarily replaced by {{ii|Eye of the Herald}}.
* [[File:A Harmless Scarecrow Surprise Party.png|30px|border]] - {{csl|Fiddlesticks|Surprise Party}} has a special icon for this ability.

params.blurb: {{sbc|Passive:}} While {{ci|Fiddlesticks}} is unseen or impersonating an {{ai|A Harmless Scarecrow|Fiddlesticks|effigy}}, its next damaging ability will briefly {{tip|fear}} targets hit.
params.blurb2: {{sbc|Active:}} '''Fiddlesticks''' screeches at the target enemy, {{tip|fear|fearing}} them and dealing {{as|magic damage}} based on the {{as|target's '''current''' health}}.
params.blurb3: If the target has recently been feared by '''Fiddlesticks''', ''Terrify'' will instead deal {{ccs|double damage|magic}}.
params.description: {{sbc|Passive:}} While '''Fiddlesticks''' has been [[combat status|out of combat]] for at least {{tt|{{fd|2.25}} seconds|Estimated}} and is not {{tip|sight|visible}} to the enemy team, or is impersonating an ''{{ai|A Harmless Scarecrow|Fiddlesticks|Effigy}}'', its damaging ability will additionally {{tip|fear}} targets hit for a duration.
params.description2: {{sbc|Active:}} '''Fiddlesticks''' launches a crow at the target enemy which arrives after {{tt|{{fd|0.35}} seconds|Fixed travel time from the start of the cast time}}, dealing {{as|magic damage}} and {{tip|fear|fearing}} them for a duration. ''Terrify'' has a minimum damage threshold and is capped at 400 against {{tip|monsters}}.
params.description3: Targets feared by '''Fiddlesticks''' by any means cannot be affected by it again for a duration equal to ''Terrify's'' cooldown. Against these targets, ''Terrify's'' {{ccs|damage|magic}} and minimum threshold are doubled.
params.leveling3:
{{st|Increased Magic Damage|{{as|{{ap|4*2 to 6*2}}% {{as|(+ {{ap|3*2}}% per 100 AP)}} of target's '''current''' health}}}}
{{st|Increased Minimum Damage|{{ap|40*2 to 120*2}}}}
params.notes:
* The fear-immunity timer is not refreshed by subsequent attempts to {{tip|fear}} the target.
** [[Monster#Epic monsters|Epic monsters]] are immune to the crowd control effect of {{tip|fear}}, but are still affected by the fear-immunity timer. ''Terrify'' will therefore deal doubled damage to them while the timer is active.
* The fear-immunity timer is applied even if the target is {{tip|cc-immune|crowd control immune}}. It is not applied if the effect is blocked by a {{tip|spell shield}}.
* The {{tip|fear}} from ''Terrify'' is applied {{tt|at the end of the cast time|0.363 seconds after the start of cast, due to game tick rate}}, regardless of the target's distance.
** Since [[V14.14|V14.14]], the missile can be destroyed by {{tip|projectile|projectile-interception}} effects.
* ''Terrify'' will still cast and affect the target even if '''Fiddlesticks''' dies or loses {{tip|sight}} of them during the cast time.
* The meaning of "[[combat status|out of combat]]" in ''Terrify's'' description is somewhat imprecise. For the purposes of its passive, '''Fiddlesticks''' becomes eligible to fear approximately {{tt|{{fd|2.25}} seconds|Estimated}} after it has stopped dealing damage, not taken damage from an '''enemy {{ui|champion}}''', and not been affected by {{tip|crowd control}}.
** Dealing damage to any unit counts for this purpose, including {{tip|champion|champions}}, {{tip|minion|minions}}, {{tip|monster|monsters}}, {{tip|turret|turrets}}, [[inhibitor|inhibitors]], [[jungle plant|jungle plants]], {{tip|ward|wards}}, and summoned units.
***Damage dealt to monsters by [[Named item effect#Jungle Companions|Jungle Companions]] also does not reset the timer.
** Using {{si|Exhaust}} on an enemy champion also breaks this state despite dealing no damage. Other non-damaging summoner spells do not.
** Damage from non-champion units does not break this state. However, crowd control from non-champion units still does, which is especially relevant when fighting {{ui|Ocean Drake}} and {{ui|Hextech Drake}}.
* Enemy {{tip|sight}} from any source can prevent the unseen condition from being satisfied.
**impersonating an {{ai|A Harmless Scarecrow|Fiddlesticks|effigy}} allows {{ai|Bountiful Harvest|Fiddlesticks}} and {{ai|Reap|Fiddlesticks}} to fear enemies even when seen.
* The passive portion does not communicate any information to '''Fiddlesticks''', its allies, nor its enemies, of whether '''Fiddlesticks''' is eligible to apply {{tip|fear}}.
** While '''Fiddlesticks''' is channeling {{ai|Crowstorm|Fiddlesticks}}, a visual indicator will circle around enemy champions if the unseen requirement was satisfied when the channel began. This indicator is visible only to '''Fiddlesticks''', but does not guarantee that ''Crowstorm'' will apply {{tip|fear}}, as enemy gaining {{tip|sight}} or taking champion damage during the channel can invalidate the passive before ''Crowstorm'' deals damage.
** The indicator briefly appears when {{ai|Crowstorm|Fiddlesticks}} is cast even if ''Terrify'' has not been learned, but disappears almost immediately.
* There is a very brief grace period after '''Fiddlesticks''' becomes visible or enters combat during which ''Terrify's'' passive can remain active.
** This allows '''Fiddlesticks''' to move slightly out of vision-blocking terrain, such as brush, or immediately retaliate after being revealed and still apply {{tip|fear}}.
** This grace period is shorter than the cast times of '''Fiddlesticks's''' basic abilities, so the fear-applying effect can not affect multiple basic abilities.
** {{ai|Crowstorm|Fiddlesticks}} is an exception. After '''Fiddlesticks''' [[blink|blinks]] from an unseen location into enemy vision using {{ai|Crowstorm|Fiddlesticks}}, an ability immediately cast after arriving will still apply {{tip|fear}} before the grace period expires. This allows interactions such as ''Crowstorm'' into {{ai|Reap|Fiddlesticks}}, as well as the ''Crowstorm''–{{ai|Bountiful Harvest|Fiddlesticks}}–{{si|Flash}} interaction.
* {{si|Flash|Flashing}} into enemy vision immediately removes ''Terrify's'' passive fear-applying eligibility and removes the normal grace period.
** However, if an ability that is already eligible to apply {{tip|fear}} is cast during the grace period before using ''Flash'', that cast retains its fear effect after the ''Flash''. This allows for the ''Crowstorm''–''Bountiful Harvest''–''Flash'' interaction.
* The interaction between ''Terrify's'' passive and {{tip|monster|monsters}} differs from its interaction with enemy champions.
** If '''Fiddlesticks''' is out of combat and '''not visible''' to a particular monster, {{ai|Bountiful Harvest|Fiddlesticks}}, {{ai|Reap|Fiddlesticks}}, and {{ai|Crowstorm|Fiddlesticks}} will always apply {{tip|fear}} to that monster even if '''Fiddlesticks''' is visible to the enemy team.
*** Visibility is checked individually for each monster. '''Fiddlesticks''' may be visible to other monsters, including monsters from the same camp, without preventing fear against a monster whose sight of it is obstructed.
** If '''Fiddlesticks''' is out of combat and is '''visible''' to a particular monster, {{ai|Bountiful Harvest|Fiddlesticks}} will '''not''' apply {{tip|fear}} to that monster.
** If '''Fiddlesticks''' is out of combat, is '''visible''' to a particular monster as well as being '''visible''' to the enemy team, {{ai|Reap|Fiddlesticks}} and {{ai|Crowstorm|Fiddlesticks}} will '''not''' apply {{tip|fear}} to that monster.
*** {{ai|Crowstorm|Fiddlesticks}} behaves differently against monsters than against champions. Even if ''Crowstorm's'' initial channel location is visible to a particular monster and to the enemy team, if the first damaging instance of ''Crowstorm'' occurs in a location where '''Fiddlesticks''' is not visible to that monster, that monster will be {{tip|fear|feared}}.
**** Subsequent damage instances of ''Crowstorm'' cannot independently satisfy the out-of-combat condition because the first instance has already caused '''Fiddlesticks''' to enter combat.
* {{tip|minion|Minions}} use the same fear conditions as enemy champions.
* The [[summoner|player's]] screen will have a visual effect when successfully {{tip|flee|feared}} by ''Terrify''.
* [[File:Terrify Surprise Party.png|30px|border]] - {{csl|Fiddlesticks|Surprise Party}} has a special icon for this ability.
params.tips:
* {{tip|Nearsight}} reduces an enemy {{tip|champion|champion's}} {{tip|sight}} radius, thus allowing '''Fiddlesticks''' to utilize the passive portion of ''Terrify'' more effectively.
* Because a {{tip|spell shield}} prevents the fear-immunity timer from being applied, if the {{tip|fear}} from another ability is blocked by a spell shield, '''Fiddlesticks''' can follow up with ''Terrify'' to fear the target again. This allows '''Fiddlesticks''' to effectively bypass a single spell shield when chaining its abilities.

blurb.plain: Passive: While Fiddlesticks is unseen or impersonating an effigy, its next damaging ability will briefly fear targets hit.

blurb2.plain: Active: Fiddlesticks screeches at the target enemy, fearing them and dealing magic damage based on the target's current health.

blurb3.plain: If the target has recently been feared by Fiddlesticks, Terrify will instead deal double damage.

description.plain: Passive: While Fiddlesticks has been out of combat for at least 2.25 seconds and is not visible to the enemy team, or is impersonating an Effigy, its damaging ability will additionally fear targets hit for a duration.

description2.plain: Active: Fiddlesticks launches a crow at the target enemy which arrives after 0.35 seconds, dealing magic damage and fearing them for a duration. Terrify has a minimum damage threshold and is capped at 400 against monsters.

description3.plain: Targets feared by Fiddlesticks by any means cannot be affected by it again for a duration equal to Terrify's cooldown. Against these targets, Terrify's damage and minimum threshold are doubled.

The final tick at the end of the channel deals additional {{as|magic damage}}, capped at 400 against {{tip|monsters}}. ''Bountiful Harvest'' deals {{ap|1.35*100}}% damage against {{tip|monsters}} and {{ap|0.50*100}}% damage against {{tip|minions}}.

blurb.plain: Active: Fiddlesticks tethers to nearby enemies, channeling for a short duration during which it reveals tethered enemies and continually deals magic damage to them. Fiddlesticks heals for a portion of the damage dealt.

description.plain: Active: Fiddlesticks forms a tether between itself and each nearby enemy over the cast time, then channels for up to 2 seconds to harvest their souls, revealing them in the process.

description2.plain: While Fiddlesticks is channeling, the tethered enemies are dealt magic damage every 0.25 seconds. The final tick at the end of the channel deals additional magic damage, capped at 400 against monsters. Bountiful Harvest deals 135% damage against monsters and 50% damage against minions.

description4.plain: Bountiful Harvest ends if all targets have died or broken their tethers. If the channel was not interrupted, 60% of the current cooldown is refunded.

description5.plain: A nearby enemy is required to cast this ability. The target does not have to be visible to be tethered by this ability.
